result.instructions: Tools for Upstash, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List all my Upstash Redis databases and their regions."; "How much traffic did my main cache get over the last 7 days?"; "Create a backup of the sessions database named before-migration.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Upstash data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run upstash_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run upstash_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run upstash_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. upstash_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: upstash_list_databases
tools.title: List Redis databases
tools.description: List all Redis databases in the account with name, region, state, TLS and plan settings. Good first call. Developer API: GET /v2/redis/databases.

tools.name: upstash_get_database
tools.title: Get a Redis database
tools.description: Get one Redis database by id: plan, region, endpoint, limits, eviction, daily backup and read regions. Credentials are never returned. Developer API: GET /v2/redis/database/{id}?credentials=hide.

tools.name: upstash_get_database_stats
tools.title: Get database stats
tools.description: Get the usage stats of a Redis database over a time window. Developer API: GET /v2/redis/stats/{id}.

period.description: Time window of the series. Defaults to 1h. 30d needs a Pro plan or the Production Pack.

tools.name: upstash_get_database_traffic
tools.title: Get database traffic
tools.description: Get the traffic time series of a Redis database over a time window. Developer API: GET /v2/redis/traffic/{id}.

period.description: Time window of the series. Defaults to 1h. 30d needs a Pro plan or the Production Pack.

tools.name: upstash_list_backups
tools.title: List database backups
tools.description: List the backups of a Redis database. Developer API: GET /v2/redis/list-backup/{id}.

tools.name: upstash_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List the teams the account belongs to. Developer API: GET /v2/teams.

tools.name: upstash_list_team_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List the members of one team. Developer API: GET /v2/teams/{team_id}.

tools.name: upstash_rename_database
tools.title: Rename a Redis database
tools.description: Change the display name of a Redis database. Does not change its endpoint or data. Developer API: POST /v2/redis/rename/{id}.

name.description: The new name of the database.

tools.name: upstash_create_backup
tools.title: Create a database backup
tools.description: Create a named manual backup of a Redis database now. Each call makes a new backup. Developer API: POST /v2/redis/create-backup/{id}.

name.description: The name of the new backup.

tools.name: upstash_enable_daily_backup
tools.title: Enable daily backups
tools.description: Turn on daily automatic backups for a Redis database. Developer API: PATCH /v2/redis/enable-dailybackup/{id}.

tools.name: upstash_disable_daily_backup
tools.title: Disable daily backups
tools.description: Turn off daily automatic backups for a Redis database. Developer API: PATCH /v2/redis/disable-dailybackup/{id}.
